desc:
App Store and Google Play listing optimization makes your store page clear, accurate and easy to find. Ecom Swift LLC writes the title, subtitle, descriptions and keyword fields for both stores and designs screenshots that explain what your app does.

## What is app store listing optimization?

Listing optimization is the work of improving the text and images on your store page so the right people find the app and understand it quickly. It covers the title, subtitle, short and long descriptions, keyword fields, screenshots, graphics and update notes.

Apple's App Store and Google Play treat these fields differently. Each store has its own limits, search behavior and rules, so one text pasted into both usually performs worse than text written for each.

## Why does the store page matter so much?

Your store page is the first place most new users meet your app. They see the icon, the title and a few screenshots, and decide within moments whether to read on. A vague title, a wall of text or screenshots that show only a login screen send them back to the search results.

Search also works through this page. Both stores read the title, description and keyword fields to decide when to show your app. If the words people actually type are missing, your app is harder to find.

## How listing quality affects installs

A clear page does two jobs. It helps the store match your app to relevant searches, and it persuades visitors who arrive to press install. Screenshots with short captions can explain the main benefits faster than a paragraph can.

We cannot promise a position in search results, because rankings depend on many factors outside any listing, including ratings, update history and competition. What we can do is remove avoidable weaknesses: unclear wording, wasted keyword space and weak visuals. Accurate pages also reduce mismatched installs, where people expect something the app does not do.

## What a great store listing includes

- A title that includes your name and one clear search phrase.
- A subtitle on Apple, or a short description on Google Play, that states the main benefit.
- A long description that opens with the answer and follows with features.
- Keyword fields on the App Store, filled with terms people really search for.
- Short promotional text that can be changed without a new release.
- Screenshots in a logical order, each with a short caption.
- A feature graphic for Google Play and a storyboard for an app preview video.
- Update text that tells users what changed in plain words.
- Optional translations for markets where you have customers.
- A check against Apple and Google listing rules.

## What we do

We start with your app, your audience and a few competing apps. We choose the search phrases that fit, then write the text within each store's limits. Claims that cannot be shown in the app are left out, because both stores can reject them.

Basic delivers text for one store, ready to paste. Standard covers both stores, keyword research, a first screenshot set and update text. Premium adds more screenshots, a Google Play feature graphic, a video storyboard, a second language and entry of the listing in your accounts. You can paste the text yourself or give us limited access.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Lead with the main benefit in the first lines of the description.
- Use words your customers use, not internal product names.
- Show real app screens in the screenshots.
- Update your listing after major releases.
- Check the text once more against store rules before submission.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing the title and keywords with unrelated terms.
- Using other brands' names to attract searches.
- Claiming features the app does not have.
- Showing screenshots that look different from the real app.
- Leaving the same text unchanged for years.

## Who this service is for

An owner who just finished an app and needs a first listing. A team whose downloads are low despite a good product. A business entering a new country that needs a second language and a localized page.

## What we need from you

A short description of the app, your audience, a few competitor names and access to a build or screenshots. If you want us to enter the listing, add us as a limited user in App Store Connect and Google Play Console. We never need passwords.
